newsitem.title: USA: High Plains Wheat - Farmers reluctant to sell.
newsitem.headline: High Plains Wheat - Farmers reluctant to sell.

text.p: Despite a sharp jump in cash wheat bids since Thursday, wheat farmers in the High Plains resisted selling more wheat on hopes prices would continue to rise, grain dealers said.
Light cash sales early Thursday dried up when the futures sped sharply higher at midday Thursday. Dealers said the gains encouraged farmers to hold out for even higher prices.

Gains Thursday also had some farmers cancelling new-crop sales, so they could resell the wheat later at higher prices. However, new crop sales have been light because farmers were unsure how much wheat was lost during the latest freeze.
"It is just too early to tell how much damage is out there," said an Oklahoma dealer.
Basis values in cents/bu against KCBT wheat, cash=dollars/bu.
(Note: K=KCBT May wheat futures. unq- unquoted, na - not applicable)
